iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽署了多項大型合作，包括價值 **34 億美元** 的五年 AI Cloud 合約、最高 **21 億美元** 的投資權利，以及共同規劃最高 **5 GW** 的 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎設施，並將投資與 GPU 部署量掛鉤【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。

- **AI Cloud 合約**：IREN 與 NVIDIA 簽訂了 **5 年、34 億美元** 的 AI Cloud 合約，採用空冷 Blackwell GPU，部署將在 Childress 既有資料中心的 **60 MW** 容量內展開，並於 2027 年初開始加速擴張【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- **投資權利**：NVIDIA 獲得 IREN 五年內以每股 **70 美元** 購買最多 **3,000 萬** 普通股的權利，若全部行使則相當於 **21 億美元** 的潛在投資額【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- **投資結構**：此 **21 億美元** 投資僅在 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施實際部署後才會逐步解鎖，全部解鎖條件為部署 **600,000 台 GPU**【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **2026 年建設目標**：IREN 計畫在 2026 年完成 **480 MW** 的 AI Cloud 容量、部署 **150,000 台 GPU**，並在年底前達成 **37 億美元** 的 ARR 目標【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **2027 年擴張藍圖**：2027 年將把總容量擴大至 **1,210 MW**，其中 **730 MW** 正在建設中，主要分布於 Childress（約 **450 MW**）與 Sweetwater（約 **280 MW**）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **ARR 與收入**：與 NVIDIA 合約相關的已簽 ARR 約為 **7 億美元**，支撐空冷 Blackwell GPU 在 Childress 的 **60 MW** 容量；未合約的 2026 年剩餘空冷容量約含 **50,000 台 GPU**【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **資金與財務狀況**：IREN 持有 **26 億美元** 現金，預期透過 GPU 融資與預付款支撐近期資本支出【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

以上即為近期 NVIDIA 與 IREN 之間的主要合作內容。

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang
AFP
Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:02 AM GMT+8
2 min read

Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

records.query: NVIDIA 財報前，新聞關注它面臨哪些競爭與市場焦點？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在財報公布前的新聞主要聚焦於它正面臨來自 **Cerebras**、**AMD** 以及自家客戶 **Amazon (AMZN)** 與 **Google (GOOG/GOOGL)** 的 AI 晶片競爭，同時市場焦點放在 AI 晶片需求與大型 GPU 基礎建設的部署上。  

- **Cerebras** 於近期完成 IPO，推出與 Nvidia 不同的 AI 處理器，並聲稱具備更快的整體效能，成為 Nvidia 的直接競爭者【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- **AMD** 預計在今年稍後推出可與 Nvidia 競爭的機架級伺服器系統，亦被列為主要競爭對手【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- **Amazon** 已將自家 AI 晶片業務的年營收跑道提升至 **超過 200 億美元（$20 billion）**，且以三位數的年增率成長，顯示其在 AI 晶片市場的快速擴張，且 Amazon 也開始向第三方客戶提供自家 AI 晶片，直接與 Nvidia 競爭【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- **Google**（GOOG/GOOGL）同樣向第三方客戶提供自家 AI 晶片，亦被視為 Nvidia 的競爭來源【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

此外，新聞亦提到 **AI 雲端與 GPU 基礎建設** 的市場動向：Nvidia 正在與 IREN 合作部署大量 GPU（目標 2026 年部署 150,000 顆 GPU，2027 年擴增至更大規模），顯示公司正聚焦於擴大 AI 雲端算力與相關基礎設施的佈局【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

總結來說，新聞在財報前聚焦於 Nvidia 必須應對來自 Cerebras、AMD、Amazon 與 Google 的多方競爭，同時持續擴大 AI 晶片與 GPU 雲端部署以鞏固市場領先地位。

最近，**Magnificent Seven** 的股價普遍呈下跌趨勢，但仍有個別股票出現上漲。根據路透社 6 月 12 日的報導，因對 SpaceX IPO 的擔憂，對沖基金拋售了這些大型科技股，導致「Magnificent Seven」自上週五以來全部下跌 [NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。同時，當日仍有以下幾檔股票逆勢上漲：

- **Nvidia (NVDA)** 上漲 **+2.22 %**  
- **Apple (AAPL)** 上漲 **+1.39 %**  
- **Amazon (AMZN)** 上漲 **+1.47 %**  
- **Alphabet/Google (GOOG/GOOGL)** 上漲 **+0.92 %**  

[NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]

**Tesla (TSLA)** 的股價則出現兩次相反走勢，顯示近期波動較大：

- 6 月 12 日的影片報導中，Tesla 股價上漲 **+4.60 %** [TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。  
- 7 月 20 日的即時盈餘報導中，Tesla 股價下跌 **-2.96 %** [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。

綜合以上資訊，近期「Magnificent Seven」整體受壓，除 Nvidia、Apple、Amazon、Alphabet 略有上揚外，Tesla 的股價在不同日子呈現顯著的正負波動。

新聞指出，Apple 的服務業務正以雙位數的速度成長，且屬於高毛利的收入來源，對公司整體獲利具有正面助益。  

- 服務部門的內容與廣告收入重新加速，實現了「雙位數成長」​[AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。  
- 分析師認為，憑藉 25 億部以上的裝置安裝基礎，服務業務的成長預計將超過 **14%**​[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]。  
- 同時，新聞提到 Apple 的整體毛利率已突破 **48%**，而服務被描述為「高毛利」的收入項目​[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]。  

因此，從新聞內容看，Apple 服務業務不僅持續快速擴張，亦因其高毛利特性，對公司整體獲利能力產生了正面的支撐。

records.query: 新聞報導 Apple 為什麼被視為值得長期持有的股票？
records.answer:
Apple 被視為值得長期持有的原因在於其龐大的裝置基礎與生態系統鎖定、高毛利服務收入、強勁的現金產生與財務健康，以及持續的資本回饋政策，使其在變動的市場中具備穩定的成長與防禦力【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。

**主要支撐因素**  

1. **裝置基礎與生態系統**  
   - Apple 擁有超過 25 億台裝置的安裝基礎，生態系統鎖定提升了客戶黏著度，讓公司在宏觀環境不佳時仍具韌性【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  

2. **高毛利服務與 AI 佈局**  
   - 服務部門交付雙位數成長，成為高毛利的收入來源，且隨著 Apple Intelligence 功能在各裝置上擴散，預期未來將帶來多年度升級、貨幣化提升與持續的經常性收入【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  

3. **強勁的現金流與資本回饋**  
   - TTM 自由現金流達 **1,292 億美元（$129.2 billion）**，足以覆蓋 **77 億美元（$7.7 billion）** 的股息與 **370 億美元（$37.0 billion）** 的回購（FY 2026 上半年）【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
   - 現金與有價證券合計 **1,466 億美元（$146.6 billion）**，遠高於 **827 億美元（$82.7 billion）** 的長期負債，淨現金持正且持續成長，顯示資產負債表「堡壘級」【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

4. **卓越的盈利能力**  
   - 毛利率 **47.9%**（TTM）高於大多數同業，營業利率 **32.6%**，EBITDA 利率 **35.4%**，槓桿自由現金流利率 **22.4%**，股東權益報酬率 **141.5%**，均領先同業【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

5. **估值與回報**  
   - 雖然前瞻本益比 **33.5x** 高於大多數同業，但市場為其服務組合、資本回饋與品牌護城河支付溢價；股息提升與 **1,000 億美元（$100 billion）** 的新回購計畫為投資人提供明確的回報底線【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

6. **穩定的成長與長期複利**  
   - 受 iPhone 17 週期推動 **+23%** 成長，加上服務部門的高毛利，Apple 的三年營收 CAGR 為 **5.4%**，在同業中屬於較為穩健的複利者【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

綜合以上，分析師認為 Apple 具備「韌性、獲利能力、現金充裕與持續回饋」的特質，是「核心持股」且適合長期投資的標的【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。

records.query: NVIDIA 最新財報顯示的營收成長速度如何？加上新聞中它與 IREN 最新的 AI 雲端合作案，這反映出公司在資料中心布局上的哪些具體進展？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在最新的財報（2026 年第一季）中，營收較去年同期大幅成長 **約 85%**，從 440.62 億美元（$44.062 billion） 提升至 816.15 億美元（$81.615 billion）【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #48】。  

此高速成長主要來自資料中心相關的 Compute & Networking 部門，該部門營收從 395.89 億美元（$39.589 billion） 增至 745.5 億美元（$74.550 billion），年增率 **88%**，而 Graphics 部門亦上升 **58%**，共同推動整體營收的 85% 成長【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #48】。  

---

### 與 IREN 的最新 AI 雲端合作案顯示的資料中心布局具體進展

1. **大型長期 AI Cloud 合約**  
   - NVIDIA 與 IREN 簽署了 **5 年、價值 34 億美元（$3.4 billion）** 的 AI Cloud 合約，合約金額會隨 GPU 部署而逐步解鎖【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
   - 合約中包含 **5 GW** 的 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎設施部署目標，並以 **600,000 顆 GPU** 為完全授權條件【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

2. **資本投入與股權認購權**  
   - NVIDIA 獲得 IREN 授予的 **5 年、最高可認購 0.3 億（30 million） 股、每股 $70** 的認購權，若全額行使相當於 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion）** 的潛在投資【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  

3. **即時部署規模**  
   - IREN 計畫於 2026 年部署 **480 MW** 的 AI Cloud 容量，對應約 **150,000 顆 GPU**，並於 2027 年擴增至 **1,210 MW**（其中 730 MW 正在建設中）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
   - 其中 **60 MW** 的空冷 Blackwell GPU 會在 Childress 站點部署，與 NVIDIA 合約直接掛鉤，已產生約 **7 億美元（$700 million）** 的 ARR【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

4. **地理布局與建設進度**  
   - IREN 正在美國德州 Sweetwater、Childress、以及加拿大 BC 等地建設液冷與空冷資料中心，2026 年的 **300 MW** Childress 液冷項目已於 Q3 交付給 Microsoft，後續 Horizon 2‑4 於年末完成【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
   - 歐洲方面，透過收購 Nostrum Group，IREN 增添 **490 MW** 的西班牙電力供應，為未來在歐洲的 AI 基礎設施鋪路【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

5. **ARR 目標與現況**  
   - IREN 已將合約下的年度經常性收入（ARR）提升至 **31 億美元（$3.1 billion）**，預計在 2026 年底達到 **37 億美元（$3.7 billion）**，其中約 **7 億美元（$700 million）** 直接與 NVIDIA 的 AI Cloud 合約掛鉤【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

---

### 整體解讀

- **營收高速成長** 反映 NVIDIA 受惠於資料中心產品（尤其是 Blackwell 系列）需求激增，Compute & Networking 部門的營收與營業收入均呈現兩位數增長。  
- **與 IREN 的合作** 不僅帶來巨額長期合約與潛在股權投資，亦具體化為 **GW 級電力供應、百萬級 GPU 部署** 以及 **多地點（美國、加拿大、歐洲）資料中心擴建**，顯示 NVIDIA 正在以硬體供應與金融資本雙管齊下，深化其在全球 AI 資料中心生態系的布局。  

這些數據共同說明，NVIDIA 正透過產品銷售與戰略合作雙向推動，快速擴張其資料中心基礎設施，鞏固在 AI 計算市場的領先地位。

IREN Shares Jump as Nvidia Deal Sharpens Bitcoin Miner’s AI Pivot
$IREN
$NVDA
2 hours ago
By: CryptoProwl
IREN Limited (NASDAQ:
$IREN
) shares jumped in after-hours trading on Thursday after the company announced a new Nvidia (NASDAQ:
$NVDA
) partnership that gives its AI infrastructure pivot a much larger public-market signal. The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT] Anthropic said partners may share that ‌information with security teams at other companies, ​industry bodies, regulators and ​government agencies, open-source maintainers, the media or the public, subject to responsible-disclosure norms. The Pentagon is deploying Mythos to find and patch software vulnerabilities across ​the U.S. government even as ‌it races to complete a transition away from the AI company, the ​Defense Department's top technology official said last week. Alphabet 近一年（TTM）營收成長率為 **21.8%**【GOOGL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。  

此成長與 Navan 與 Google Gemini 的合作案例一起，顯示 Google 在 AI 生態系布局的幾項具體進展：

1. **AI‑驅動的旅行預訂平台**：Navan（前身為 TripActions）在最新的財報說明中提到與 Google Gemini 的合作，透過 AI 讓使用者能在 Gemini Enterprise 內直接完成全程旅行預訂【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
2. **擴大未受管理的市場**：Google 透過 Gemini 首次服務「從未管理過旅行」的消費者，這類未受管理的市場正以極快速度成長，顯示 Google 正在開拓全新使用者群【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
3. **產品化的 AI 代理人**：Navan 代表說明 Gemini 能將飛行、住宿等資訊結合，提供可重複使用的 AI 代理人，讓同一套 AI 能在多種情境下交付服務，這是 Google 在 AI 能力模組化與即時部署方面的突破【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
4. **自助式（PLG）成長動能**：Navan 提到其 PLG（Product‑Led Growth）動能在上一季「翻倍」成長，說明 AI 整合提升了產品自助採用率，間接證明 Google Gemini 的技術正驅動客戶快速上手【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
5. **跨平台整合能力**：在對話中 Navan 表示，只要使用 Gemini Enterprise，即可在同一平台完成整個行程的預訂，顯示 Google 正在打造可與多種應用深度整合的 AI 生態，提升使用者體驗與黏著度【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

綜合以上，Alphabet 透過 Gemini 的 AI 能力不僅提升了自身在旅行預訂領域的市場佔有率，也展示了其在 AI 代理人、未受管理市場開拓、產品自助成長（PLG）以及跨平台整合等多面向的戰略布局。

records.query: Meta 目前的毛利率如何？加上新聞中 Morgan Stanley 對其 AI 護城河與資本支出的評價，市場如何綜合看待 Meta 的 AI 投資？
records.answer:
Meta 目前的毛利率約為 **81.94%**（Gross Margin = 0.81941）【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。

- Morgan Stanley 分析師 Brian Nowak 表示，Meta 正在進行「大規模人工智慧支出」以擴大其競爭護城河，預估 2027‑2028 年的資本支出將達 **3,800 億美元（$380 billion）**，雖然投資規模尚未完全透明，但預期可在 2028 年為每股盈餘貢獻 **$1‑$3**【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 他亦指出，Meta AI 的搜尋功能若能吸引 10 億使用者並將每日查詢的 10% 變現，將產生 **超過 100 億美元（$10 billion）** 的年營收【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 為了提升高利潤率，Meta 已開始推出分層訂閱方案，並將此視為未來高毛利收入來源【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 基於上述 AI 投資與護城河的正面預期，Morgan Stanley 再次將 Meta 列為「最佳永續持有」股票，給予 **$775** 的目標價【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

綜合而言，市場（以 Morgan Stanley 為代表）認為 Meta 的 AI 相關資本支出雖具規模與不確定性，但其潛在的搜尋收入與高利潤訂閱服務將加強公司毛利率與長期成長前景，因而對其 AI 投資持相對樂觀的態度。**然而**，分析師同時提醒，其他 AI 股票可能提供更高的上行空間與較低的下行風險，暗示市場仍在比較不同 AI 投資的風險回報【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

records.query: Tesla 目前的毛利率表現如何？加上新聞中 SpaceX 即將 IPO 讓 Tesla 關注度降溫的報導，這對 Tesla 目前的市場處境有何影響？
records.answer:
Tesla 目前的毛利率已下降至約 **16.8%**（2026 年第二季），較去年同季的 **17.2%** 下降 0.4 個百分點【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- 其中汽車與服務其他部門的總毛利率從 2025 年第三季的 **17.2%** 下降至 2026 年第三季的 **16.9%**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- 能源發電與儲能部門的毛利率則從 2025 年第三季的 **30.3%** 大幅跌至 2026 年第三季的 **20.4%**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  

SpaceX 即將於 2026 年 6 月 12 日在 Nasdaq 以 **$135** 每股的價格上市的消息，已在市場上引發注意力轉移。根據 JPMorgan 資料，對於 SpaceX IPO 前的預期，對沖基金拋售了包括 Tesla 在內的「Magnificent Seven」科技股，導致相關股票自上週五以來皆出現下跌，且追蹤這七大科技股的 Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF 自 6 月 5 日以來已下跌超過 **2.4%**【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 此賣壓顯示投資者在 SpaceX IPO 前將資金從大型科技股（含 Tesla）轉移，短期內降低了 Tesla 的市場關注度與股價支撐。  

另一方面，Yahoo Finance 的影片報導中顯示，受 SpaceX IPO 前景刺激，Tesla 股價在當日出現 **+4.60%** 的漲幅【TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。這說明市場對於 Tesla 本身仍保有一定的正面情緒，但整體而言，SpaceX IPO 的前置賣出行為已對 Tesla 及其他大型科技股造成一定的壓力，使其市場處境在短期內顯得較為疲弱。  

綜合來看，Tesla 正在面臨毛利率下降的財務壓力，同時因 SpaceX IPO 前的資金重新配置，市場對其關注度與股價表現出現兩極化的短期波動。

records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於其全棧 AI 平台，結合自家 GPU、CPU、DPU 硬體與廣泛的軟體生態系統（CUDA、數百套庫、API）以及龐大的開發者社群，形成難以被競爭者快速複製的技術與生態優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

1. **硬體領先與整合**：NVIDIA 不只提供具備 Tensor Core 的 GPU，還推出了 Grace CPU、Blackwell GPU 以及 Data Processing Unit（DPU），形成「GPU、CPU、DPU」三大處理單元的完整資料中心規模計算與網路解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過同一套可程式化的底層架構（GPU 為核心，結合 CUDA、AI 函式庫與完整軟硬體堆疊），同時在資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場佈局。  

- **統一的可程式化架構**：NVIDIA 以「可程式化的底層架構」支援多元終端市場，讓同一套硬體與軟體基礎能在不同垂直領域提供效能與規模，並透過數十萬顆 GPU 互相連結形成巨型電腦，滿足 AI、深度學習與 3D 圖形等需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

- **資料中心（Data Center）**：核心為 GPU，搭配 CPU、DPU、NVLink 交換器與高速網路，並提供 CUDA、CUDA‑X 加速函式庫、AI Enterprise、vGPU 等完整軟體堆疊，形成「全堆疊」的加速運算平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25】。  

- **遊戲（Gaming）**：利用同樣的 GPU 架構推出 GeForce RTX 系列（含 Blackwell 第 50 代），結合 RTX 光線追蹤、DLSS 以及 Tensor Core，提供更高畫質與 AI 加速的遊戲體驗；同時將 Blackwell 架構的效能與 AI 功能延伸至 GeForce NOW 雲端遊戲服務【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

- **專業視覺化（Professional Visualization）**：在 RTX PRO GPU 上加入與資料中心相同的 Tensor Core 與 AI 能力，讓 3D 設計、工程與內容創作軟體能加速工作流程，並透過 NVIDIA 的軟體生態系（CUDA、專屬加速庫）提供垂直領域最佳化【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

- **車用（Automotive）**：以 DRIVE Hyperion 平台提供從雲端到車端的完整堆疊，包括高效能的 DRIVE AGX 計算硬體、DRIVE OS 作業系統、感測器套件與模組化的軟體平台，這些元件皆基於相同的 GPU 與 AI 加速技術，支援自動駕駛、地圖與停車服務【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

因此，NVIDIA 透過同一套以 GPU 為核心、結合 CUDA 軟體平台與多樣化硬體（CPU、DPU、網路交換芯片）以及專屬 AI 與圖形功能的「加速計算平台」，在資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大領域同步提供高效能、可擴展且具 AI 能力的解決方案。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與服務，並將其收入納入「Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue」指標，作為 AI 功能提升整體產品組合的一環【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

- **產品層面**：Microsoft 365 Commercial 被描述為「AI‑powered business and productivity solutions platform」 ，將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 以及 Enterprise Mobility + Security 等整合在同一平台上【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **收入計算**：在「Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue」的定義中，明確列出「Microsoft 365 Copilot」為收入來源之一，與 Azure、LinkedIn、Dynamics 365 等雲端服務共同計算【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  
- **成長驅動**：Microsoft 365 Commercial 的營收受「持續的安裝基礎成長」與「每位使用者平均收入擴張」影響，而 Copilot 作為 AI 增值服務，屬於「新增 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 情境」的範疇，協助推動上述兩項成長因素【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **使用者與座位指標**：公司同時追蹤「Microsoft 365 Commercial seat growth」與「Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth」兩項指標，Copilot 的加入即反映在這些雲端收入與座位數的增長中【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  

綜合上述，Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 融入 Microsoft 365 全套服務、把其收入列入雲端營收指標，並以 AI 功能提升使用者體驗與每位使用者的平均營收，來實現其在 Microsoft 365 產品策略中的整合與成長目標。

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Our reportable segments are described below. Productivity and Business Processes

Our Productivity and Business Processes segment consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms. This segment primarily comprises:

•Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security, the cloud portion of Windows Commercial, the per-user portion of Power BI, Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance, and Microsoft 365 Copilot; and Microsoft 365 Commercial products, comprising Windows Commercial on-premises and Office licensed on-premises. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions, Office licensed on-premises, and other consumer services. •LinkedIn, including Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. •Dynamics products and cloud services, including Dynamics 365, comprising a set of intelligent, cloud-based applications across ERP, CRM, Power Apps, and Power Automate; and on-premises ERP and CRM applications. Microsoft 365 Commercial Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Commercial is an AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform that brings together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security to help organizations empower their employees. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users in new markets such as frontline workers, small and medium businesses, and growth markets, as well as add AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios to our core product and service offerings across communication, collaboration, analytics, security, compliance, and other AI business productivity categories. Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue is also affected by the demand for communication and storage through Outlook.com and OneDrive, which is largely driven by subscriptions and advertising. LinkedIn

LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful and transforms the way companies hire, market, sell, and learn. In addition to LinkedIn’s free services, LinkedIn offers monetized solutions designed to offer AI-enabled insights and productivity: Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. Growth will depend on our ability to increase LinkedIn member engagement on the platform and our ability to continue offering insight and AI-enabled services that provide value for our members and customers. LinkedIn revenue is mainly affected by demand from enterprises and professionals for subscriptions to Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings, as well as member engagement and the quality of the sponsored content delivered to those members to drive Marketing Solutions. Dynamics Products and Cloud Services

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management, as well as agentic AI and other low code application development platforms, for small and medium businesses, large organizations, and divisions of global enterprises. Dynamics revenue is driven by the number of users licensed and applications consumed, expansion of average revenue per user, and the continued shift to Dynamics 365, a unified set of cloud-based intelligent business applications, including our low code development platforms, such as Power Apps and Power Automate. Competition

Competitors to Office include software and global application vendors, web-based and mobile application companies, AI-first application companies, as well as local application developers.

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 並未在現有財報或新聞稿中直接說明 Windows（包括 Windows OEM 與 Devices）如何把使用者或企業自然導向 Azure 或 Copilot；目前可觀察到的只有 Windows OEM 在營收與毛利結構中的角色，以及雲端與 Copilot 相關服務本身的獨立成長情形【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。

- **Windows OEM 的營收與毛利貢獻**  
  - 在 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）三個月內，More Personal Computing 之 Windows 與 Devices 營收下降 2%，其中 Windows OEM 因 OEM 合作夥伴因記憶體價格上升而持續備貨，抵銷了 Devices 的下滑【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #107】。  
  - 同期毛利增加 13%（約 1.3 億美元），部分原因是 Windows OEM 的銷售比重提升，使整體銷售組合向較高毛利的業務傾斜【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #112】。

- **雲端服務（Azure）與 Copilot 相關收入的獨立增長**  
  - Intelligent Cloud（含 Azure）營收增長 29%，其中 Azure 與其他雲端服務的收入年增率高達 40%，顯示 Azure 本身的需求強勁【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #110】。  
  - Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入增長指標已納入 Microsoft 365 Copilot，亦即 Copilot 被視為 Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud 收入的一部份【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。

- **間接關聯的觀察**  
  - 雖然財報未說明 Windows OEM 與 Azure 或 Copilot 之間的直接交叉銷售或使用者導流機制，但 Windows OEM 的較高毛利貢獻提升了整體毛利率，間接為公司投入雲端與 AI（包括 Copilot）基礎設施提供了資金空間。  
  - 同時，Microsoft 在 2026 年的研發與行銷支出中，因 Copilot 廣告費用上升而增加，顯示公司正積極推廣 Copilot 服務【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #112】。

**結論**：根據現有資料，Microsoft 透過 Windows OEM 的毛利提升與 Azure、Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud（含 Copilot）本身的高速成長，提升了整體雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度；但沒有具體證據顯示 Windows OEM 直接帶動 Azure 或 Copilot 的使用率。

Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. Collectively, these costs reflect the investments we make in order to offer a wide variety of products and services to our customers, including expenditures related to initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices and the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services. We seek to invest efficiently in numerous areas of technology and infrastructure so we may continue to enhance the customer experience and improve our process efficiency through rapid technology developments, while operating at an ever increasing scale. Our technology and infrastructure investment and capital spending projects often support a variety of product and service offerings due to geographic expansion and the cross-functionality of our systems and operations. These costs are allocated to segments based on usage. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在面臨多項針對其 AWS、Prime 以及電商平台的反壟斷與監管風險，主要包括競爭法與消費者保護法的調查、資料隱私規範的審查，以及可能導致高額罰款與營運成本上升的合規挑戰【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

- **競爭/反壟斷調查**：美國與其他國家的政府與監管機構已對 Amazon 的商店營運、履行網路（fulfillment network）與 Prime 服務，以及 AWS 的雲端服務提出「可能違反競爭相關或消費者保護規則」的指控，並展開正式或非正式的調查【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113】【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。Amazon 表示將「強力爭議」這些指控並「積極防禦」相關訴訟。

- **資料隱私與數據治理**：除競爭問題外，Amazon 亦面臨一系列關於「資料收集、使用與揭露」的法律與規範審查，這些規範正處於不斷演變之中，導致未來監管機構對其隱私實務的判斷充滿不確定性【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

- **潛在財務與營運衝擊**：若調查結果導致不利的法律決定或罰款，Amazon 可能承擔「巨額金額的罰金」或「額外的合規成本」，這將增加營運成本、限制業務模式，甚至可能損害品牌聲譽與成長前景【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

- **監管環境的持續加劇**：監管機構與立法者正將 Amazon 列為「線上門戶」(gatekeeper) 之類別，透過既有法規與新法規加強監管，進一步提升合規負擔並限制其業務操作自由度【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。  

以上風險皆集中在 AWS、Prime 以及整體電商平台的競爭行為與資料治理層面，且 Amazon 已明確表態將「堅決抗辯」並「積極防禦」相關調查與訴訟。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 系列大型語言模型嵌入搜尋、YouTube、Google Workspace、以及所有主要平台與裝置，讓 AI 功能在搜尋、內容創作與企業服務中同步運作【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- 在搜尋方面，Gemini 3 以其「先進的多模態理解」與「增強推理」能力，支援 **AI Overviews**，讓使用者只要輸入自然語句即可得到即時、完整的回應；同時 **AI Mode** 讓使用者提出更複雜、需多步推理的問題，全部由 Gemini 的多模態模型處理【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- 在 YouTube 及其他內容平台，Gemini 的生成式 AI 被嵌入於產品與服務，提升影片搜尋與推薦的相關性與個人化體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 在企業與開發者生態系，Google Cloud 為客戶提供 **Gemini Enterprise** 與 **Gemini for Google Workspace**，將同樣的模型能力延伸至雲端基礎設施與協作工具，讓企業能在自家應用中直接使用 Gemini 的生成與分析功能【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 所有 15 個擁有超過五億使用者的主要產品（包括 Android、Chrome、Pixel 裝置等）皆已整合 Gemini 模型，使 AI 能在行動作業系統、瀏覽器以及硬體裝置上提供即時的智慧助理與內容生成服務【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】、【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  

透過上述多層面的嵌入，Google 將 Gemini AI 從核心搜尋功能擴展至整個產品生態系，實現「AI 為每個使用者、開發者與企業」提供即時、可靠的智慧支援。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] Table of Contents

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises. At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development. Over the last decade, our research teams have pushed the boundaries of AI forward, which is displayed through Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app. As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. We continue to help our users access information and knowledge, express themselves, and get things done by embedding the power of generative AI and Gemini into our products and platforms. Today, all 15 of our half-billion-user products — including seven with two billion users — use our Gemini models. For our Google Cloud customers, our offerings are helping organizations stay at the forefront of innovation with solutions such as Gemini Enterprise and Gemini for Google Workspace. Guided by our AI principles, we believe our approach to AI must be both bold and responsible.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] Table of Contents

Alphabet Inc. Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results. records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？

Meta 的長期願景是以 AI、穿戴裝置與虛擬/增強實境技術打造「下一代介面」與完整的元宇宙生態系，同時持續將大量資金投入 Reality Labs 進行長期研發與產品化工作【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】。

- **AI 與新平台**：Meta 正在加大 AI 模型的開發與訓練，預計未來持續提升相關投資，將 AI 融入穿戴裝置與其他新興介面中【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。  
- **Reality Labs 的長期研發**：Reality Labs 的投資聚焦於尚未上市、可能在未來十年才會實現的前瞻性產品與技術，包括 AI 與硬體創新，以支援元宇宙的長期發展【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】。  
- **具體產品路線**：在近端，Meta 已推出 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置、Meta Horizon Store 內容平台，以及結合 AI 的 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡；2024 年展示了 AR 原型 Orion，2025 年推出了 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 與搭配的 Neural Band，顯示公司正同時推動短期商業化與長期 AR 眼鏡研發【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- **財務影響**：Reality Labs 的重大投資已在 2025 年削減約 191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）的整體營業利潤，且預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似，顯示公司願意承受短期盈利壓力以換取長期技術布局【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。  
- **風險與不確定性**：Meta 承認元宇宙的市場接受度與技術標準仍具不確定性，若相關研發未能成功或未能與第三方平台達成互通，可能會對品牌、使用者基礎與財務表現產生負面影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】。  

綜合以上，Meta 的長期願景是透過 AI、穿戴與 XR（VR/AR）技術，構建一個可持續成長的元宇宙生態系，並以 Reality Labs 為核心持續投入研發，即使短期內會壓縮營運利潤，也視為實現未來十年乃至更長遠市場領導地位的必要投資。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要透過在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方行動應用程式上展示的印象型與行動型廣告來產生營收，並且把 Meta AI 作為貫穿所有 App 的智慧助理，協助內容排序、廣告工具與生成式 AI 體驗【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】；Meta AI 同時在各平台、獨立 App、AI 眼鏡與網路上提供學習、工作、內容創作與人際連結的功能，並支援內容推薦、廣告投放工具與新一代生成式 AI 服務【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  

- **廣告獲利模式**：Meta 的廣告收入來自於在其 Family of Apps（包括 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger）以及第三方行動應用程式上展示的廣告。廣告主依照廣告被展示的次數（impression）或使用者完成的特定行動（click、action）付費，Meta 在廣告印象實際送達的會計期間或使用者完成行動的會計期間確認收入；平均每則廣告的價格則以總廣告收入除以投放的廣告數量計算；對於非主要代理的廣告安排，Meta 以淨額方式確認收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- **Meta AI 的角色**：Meta AI 是一個跨平台的 AI 助理，出現在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等 App 內，也可作為獨立 App、AI 眼鏡與網路服務使用。它協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容與保持聯繫，同時支援內容排序演算法、推薦引擎、廣告主使用的工具、以及新一代的生成式 AI 體驗，並提升產品開發的效率與生產力【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **平台與產品結構**：Meta 的營運分為「Family of Apps」與「Reality Labs」兩大部門，其中 Family of Apps 包含 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Meta AI、Threads、WhatsApp 等，Meta AI 作為這些應用程式的共同 AI 助手，並與硬體（如 AI 眼鏡）整合【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

[META 10-K period 2025] 70


Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨高度競爭，來自傳統內燃機車廠、新進電動車製造商、混合動力與其他替代燃料車輛，以及供應鏈與原材料的挑戰【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。

- **傳統汽車製造商的內燃機車**：Tesla 的 Cybertruck、Model S、Model X、Model 3、Model Y 都與既有的內燃機車型（包括高階轎車、豪華 SUV、皮卡及緊湊 SUV）直接競爭，且這些競爭對手多為已建立多年、規模龐大的汽車公司【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。  
- **新進與既有廠商的電動與替代燃料車**：許多既有與新興汽車製造商已在美國、中國、歐洲等主要市場推出或計畫推出電動車，甚至提供混合動力（含插電式）車型，進一步擴大了電動車市場的競爭深度【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。  
- **替代燃料與高燃效內燃機車的競爭**：Tesla 亦需面對來自其他替代燃料車、插電式混合動力車以及燃油效率極高的傳統內燃機車的競爭壓力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62】。  
- **供應鏈與原材料挑戰**：電池原料（鋰、鎳等）價格波動與供應不穩定，以及電池供應商的產能限制，可能限制 Tesla 的產量並提升成本，進一步影響其在價格與利潤上的競爭力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62】。  
- **新進競爭者與市場飽和**：隨著更多製造商進入電動車領域，Tesla 必須持續調整策略、提升成本效益與創新，以維持其市場動能；若未能有效應對，可能面臨需求波動與營運利潤下降的風險【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #118】。  
- **宏觀經濟與政策因素**：利率上升、通膨壓力、貿易政策變動與電動車稅收抵免的取消，都可能削弱消費者購買意願，間接加劇與其他廠商的競爭【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #118】。  

綜合以上，Tesla 在電動車市場的競爭態勢是多層面的：既要與傳統汽車巨頭的內燃機車爭奪市場，又要面對快速增長的電動車新進者、混合動力與其他替代能源車型的挑戰，同時還需應對原材料供應與宏觀經濟政策帶來的間接競爭壓力。

contexts: [TSLA 10-K period 2025] We believe that our vehicles compete in the market based on both their traditional segment classification as well as their propulsion technology. For example, Cybertruck competes with other pickup trucks, Model S and Model X compete primarily with premium sedans and premium SUVs and Model 3 and Model Y compete with small to medium-sized sedans and compact SUVs, all of which are extremely competitive markets. Competing products typically include internal combustion vehicles from more established automobile manufacturers; however, many established and new automobile manufacturers have entered or have announced plans to enter the market for electric and other alternative fuel vehicles. Overall, we believe these announcements and vehicle introductions promote the development of the electric vehicle market by highlighting the attractiveness of electric vehicles relative to internal combustion vehicles. Many major automobile manufacturers have electric vehicles available today in major markets including the U.S., China and Europe, and other current and prospective automobile manufacturers are also developing electric vehicles. In addition, several manufacturers offer hybrid vehicles, including plug-in versions.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] Our cost reduction efforts, cost innovation strategies, and additional localized procurement and manufacturing are key to our vehicles’ affordability and have allowed us to competitively price our vehicles. We will also continue to generate demand by improving our vehicles’ performance and functionality, including through product offerings and features utilizing artificial intelligence such as FSD (Supervised) and other software, and delivering new vehicles and vehicle options. In addition, we believe the launch of our Robotaxi service unlocks the potential for significant business growth to advance a service-driven business model. We will continue to improve safety and profitability while scaling the network. In addition, we have been increasing awareness, and expanding our vehicle financing programs, including attractive leasing terms for our customers. We will also continue to work on developing our robotics offerings. However, we operate in a cyclical industry that is sensitive to shifting consumer trends, political and regulatory uncertainty, including with respect to trade and the environment, all of which can be compounded by inflationary pressures, rising energy prices, interest rate fluctuations and the liquidity of enterprise customers. For example, as inflationary pressures increased across the markets in which we operate, central banks in developed countries raised interest rates rapidly and substantially, which impacted the affordability of vehicle lease and finance arrangements. Further, sales of vehicles in the automotive industry also tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to increased volatility as we expand and adjust our operations. Moreover, as additional competitors enter the marketplace and help bring the world closer to sustainable transportation, we will have to adjust and continue to execute well to maintain our momentum. Additionally, our suppliers’ liquidity and allocation plans may be affected by current challenges in the automotive industry, which could reduce our access to components or result in unfavorable changes to cost. These macroeconomic and industry trends have had, and will likely continue to have, an impact on the pricing of, and order rate for our vehicles, and in turn our operating margin. Changes in government and economic policies, incentives or tariffs may also impact our production, cost structure and the competitive landscape. For instance, while the final scope and application of recently announced changes in trade policy remain uncertain at this time, higher tariffs on imports and subsequent retaliatory tariffs could adversely impact consumer spending and demand for durable goods and related services. Furthermore, certain provisions of the OBBBA, including the removal of tax credits for electric vehicles, may also impact consumer demand for electric vehicles in general. We will continue to adjust accordingly to such developments, and we believe our ongoing cost reduction efforts, including through production innovation, process improvements and logistics optimization, and focus on operating leverage, vertical integration and supply chain localization will continue to benefit us in relation to our competitors. Our new products and our advances in autonomy and robotics, position us for future growth. 32

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We also customize solutions including our energy storage products, energy generation systems and/or Solar Roof for customers to meet their specific needs. 4


Sales and Marketing

Historically, we have been able to achieve sales without relying on traditional advertising and at relatively low marketing costs. We continue to monitor our public narrative and brand, and tailor our marketing efforts accordingly, including through investments in customer education and advertising as necessary. Automotive

Direct Sales

Our vehicle sales channels currently include our website and a global network of company-owned stores. In some jurisdictions, we also have galleries to educate and inform customers about our products, but such locations do not transact in the sale of vehicles. We believe this infrastructure enables us to better control costs of inventory, manage warranty service and pricing, educate consumers about electric vehicles, make our vehicles more affordable, maintain and strengthen the Tesla brand and obtain rapid customer feedback. We reevaluate our sales strategy both globally and at a location-by-location level from time to time to optimize our sales channels. However, sales of vehicles in the automobile industry tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to volatility from time to time. Used Vehicle Sales

Our used vehicle business supports new vehicle sales by integrating the trade-in of a customer’s existing Tesla or non-Tesla vehicle with the sale of a new Tesla vehicle. The Tesla and non-Tesla vehicles we acquire as trade-ins, along with vehicles returned upon lease-end are subsequently remarketed, either directly by us or through third parties. Public Charging

We have a growing global network of Tesla Superchargers, which are our industrial-grade, high-speed vehicle chargers. Where possible, we co-locate Superchargers with our solar and energy storage systems to reduce costs and promote renewable power. Supercharger stations are typically placed along well-traveled routes and in and around dense city centers to allow vehicle owners the ability to enjoy quick, reliable charging along an extensive network with convenient stops. Use of the Supercharger network either requires payment of a fee or is free under certain sales programs. We offer Supercharger access to non-Tesla vehicles in support of our mission, with all major automakers announcing their adoption of the North American Charging Standard (NACS) in certain markets. We continue to monitor and increase our network of Tesla Superchargers in anticipation of future demand, including with respect to our Robotaxi services. We also work with a wide variety of hospitality, retail and public destinations, as well as businesses with commuting employees, to offer additional charging options for our customers, as well as single-family homeowners and multi-family residential entities, to deploy home charging solutions. To accelerate dependable charging ubiquity, Superchargers are also available through our Supercharger for Business program, where third parties can purchase and install Superchargers and set the charging price, while Tesla remains responsible for software updates, network operations, maintenance and driver support. In 2025, we opened the first Tesla Diner in California, which offers Supercharging as well as Tesla themed food and merchandise. In-App Upgrades 

As our vehicles are capable of being updated remotely over-the-air, our customers may purchase additional paid options and features through the Tesla app or through the in-vehicle user interface, which also allows us to offer certain options and features on a subscription basis. Energy Generation and Storage

We market and sell our solar and energy storage products to residential, commercial and industrial customers and utilities through a variety of channels, including through our website, stores and galleries, as well as through our network of channel partners, and in the case of some commercial customers, through PPA transactions. We emphasize simplicity, standardization and accessibility to make it easy and cost-effective for customers to adopt clean energy, while reducing our customer acquisition costs. 5


Service and Warranty

Automotive

Service

We provide service for our electric vehicles at our company-owned service locations and through Tesla Mobile Service technicians who perform work remotely at customers’ homes or other locations. Servicing the vehicles ourselves allows us to identify problems and implement solutions and improvements faster than traditional automobile manufacturers and their dealer networks. The connectivity of our vehicles also allows us to diagnose and remedy many problems remotely and proactively. Vehicle Limited Warranties and Extended Service Plans

We provide a manufacturer’s limited warranty on all new and used Tesla vehicles we sell directly to consumers, which may include limited warranties on certain components, specific types of damage or battery capacity retention. We also currently offer optional extended service plans that provide coverage after the new vehicle limited warranties end for certain models in specified regions. Energy Generation and Storage

We provide service and repairs to our energy product customers, including under warranty where applicable. We generally provide manufacturer’s limited warranties with our energy storage products and offer certain extended limited warranties that are available at the time of purchase of the system. If we install a system, we also provide certain limited warranties on our installation workmanship. For retrofit energy generation systems, we provide separate limited warranties for workmanship and against roof leaks, and for Solar Roof, we also provide limited warranties for defects and weatherization. For components not manufactured by us, we generally pass-through the applicable manufacturers’ warranties.

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務納入公司整體產品組合，作為多元化收入來源與長期獲利成長的策略之一【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 這項業務屬於公司兩大事業部之一的「Energy Generation and Storage」部門，負責設計、製造、安裝、銷售與租賃住宅、商業與工業客戶的太陽能發電與儲能產品，並提供相關服務與金融方案【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 能源儲能產品（如 Powerwall、Megapack）利用來自汽車事業的模組化電池技術與電力電子專長，並透過 Powerhub（分散式能源資源）與 Autobidder（Megapack）等軟體平台進行遠端控制與最佳化調度【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 能源生成產品（包括 2025 年開始量產的住宅翻新太陽能板與持續製造的 Solar Roof）同樣結合自家太陽能逆變器與 Powerwall，強調與儲能系統的整合性【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 在 2025 年，Tesla 部署了 46.7 GWh 的能源儲能產品，顯示該業務在當年度的實體交付規模【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  
- 公司在 10‑K 中指出，為了實現「盈利成長」與「差異化且高效管理的產品組合」，除了汽車與自動駕駛外，也持續擴大能源生成與儲能事業，利用現有工廠與產線、垂直整合供應鏈以及 AI 計算基礎建設來支撐此類產品的發展【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  

綜合上述，能源生成與儲能業務在 Tesla 的策略中扮演的是透過技術共享、軟體平台優化與產品多樣化，協助公司在汽車以外開拓新市場、提升整體營收結構與長期獲利能力的角色。

contexts: [TSLA] The company operates in two segments, Automotive; and Energy Generation and Storage. The company offers electric vehicles, as well as sells automotive regulatory credits; and non-warranty maintenance services and collision, automotive insurance services, as well as part sales and retail merchandise sale. It also provides sedans and sport utility vehicles through direct and used vehicle sales, a network of Tesla Superchargers, and in-app upgrades; purchase financing and leasing services; services for electric vehicles through its company-owned service locations and Tesla mobile service technicians; and vehicle limited warranties and extended service plans. In addition, the company engages in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, and leasing of solar energy generation and energy storage products, and related services to residential, commercial, and industrial customers and utilities through its website, stores, and galleries, as well as through a network of channel partners. Further, it provides services and repairs to its energy product customers, including under warranty and extended service plans; and various financing options to its residential customers; lithium-ion battery energy storage products, such as Powerwall and Megapack; energy generation products, including solar panels and solar roof; self-driving development and artificial intelligence software, vehicle control and infotainment software, and battery and powertrain. The company was formerly known as Tesla Motors, Inc. and changed its name to Tesla, Inc. in February 2017. Tesla, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Further leveraging our capabilities in AI, every Tesla energy storage product is capable of being enhanced through firmware updates and optimized by our software platforms, particularly Powerhub (for distributed energy resources, including Powerwall-enabled virtual power plants) and Autobidder (for Megapack batteries). Energy Generation Systems

We began manufacturing a new residential retrofit solar panel in 2025, and began initial customer deliveries in January 2026. We continue to manufacture Solar Roof, which has been engineered over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our energy generation products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Infrastructure

To support our businesses in clean energy and transport and autonomous robots, we are investing in and developing the necessary supporting infrastructure. This includes additional compute hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these artificial neural networks for real-world performance. In 2025, we further expanded Cortex, our training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, and announced a new collaboration with Samsung to manufacture advanced semiconductors for AI inference and training in the U.S. We are currently building Cortex 2 at Gigafactory Texas to further increase our AI training compute capacity. In 2026, we will be ramping six new production lines across vehicle, Bots, energy storage and battery manufacturing, while further leveraging our existing factory, charging and service center footprints to support future growth.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As a result of rapidly evolving trade and fiscal policy, uncertainty in the automotive and energy markets continues, posing risks to our global supply chain and cost structure which could have a meaningfully adverse impact on demand for our products and our profitability. The current tariff regime will have a relatively larger impact on our energy generation and storage business compared to our automotive business. While we prepare for near-term challenges to our business under current policies, we are focused on long-term growth opportunities as we continue to make prudent investments. In 2025, we produced approximately 1.66 million consumer vehicles and delivered approximately 1.64 million consumer vehicles. We are focused on profitable growth via a differentiated and efficiently managed product portfolio that leverages our existing factories and production lines, further improving and deploying our FSD (Supervised) capabilities, including future autonomous capabilities through our purpose-built Robotaxi product, Cybercab, reducing costs, increasing vehicle production, utilized capacity and delivery capabilities, improving and developing our vehicles, battery and AI compute technologies, vertically integrating and localizing our supply chain, and expanding our global infrastructure, including our service and charging infrastructure. We have continued to expand and refine our Robotaxi service after its June 2025 launch, capitalizing on our AI investments and scalable mobility infrastructure to advance a service-driven business model. In 2025, we deployed 46.7 GWh of energy storage products.

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 10‑K 中指出，它在智慧型手機、個人電腦 (PC) 與平板電腦等全球市場僅佔「少數」市場份額，且必須面對資源充足、價格激進且常模仿其產品與服務的競爭者所帶來的強大競爭壓力。  

- Apple 自己說明「在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板電腦以及穿戴裝置市場」的市佔為「少數」(minority market share)【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- 競爭因素包括「價格、產品與服務功能（含安全性）、相對價格與效能、產品與服務品質與可靠度、設計與技術創新、第三方軟硬體生態系、行銷與分銷能力、服務與支援、企業聲譽，以及保護與執行智慧財產權的能力」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- 公司指出其產品與服務面臨「來自具備顯著技術、行銷、分銷等資源的公司」的「實質」競爭，且競爭者常「模仿」Apple 的產品特性與應用，提供更具競爭力的解決方案【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- 競爭特別激烈，因為「競爭者積極降價並降低產品毛利」；有些競爭者甚至以「幾乎無利潤或虧損」的方式提供產品與服務【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。  
- Apple 亦說明「市場高度競爭，特徵包括激烈的價格競爭、毛利率下行壓力、產品性能持續提升、消費者與企業對價格的敏感度」以及「新產品與服務的頻繁推出、產品生命週期短、產業標準快速演變」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。  

綜合上述，Apple 在其 10‑K 中承認自己在智慧型手機、PC 與平板市場的佔有率屬於少數，且必須持續應對資金充裕、價格戰激烈且善於模仿的競爭者所帶來的多面向壓力。

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design and technology innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, corporate reputation, and the ability to effectively protect and enforce the Company’s intellectual property rights. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall. Supply of Components

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Europe includes European countries, as well as India, the Middle East and Africa. Greater China includes China mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Rest of Asia Pacific includes Australia, New Zealand and those Asian countries not included in the Company’s other reportable segments. Although the reportable segments provide similar hardware and software products and similar services, each one is managed separately to better align with the location of the Company’s customers and distribution partners and the unique market dynamics of each geographic region. Markets and Distribution

The Company’s customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force. The Company sells its services in the same markets through its various service platforms. The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. records.answer:
Apple 透過龐大的活躍裝置基數、吸引開發者的收入潛力與深度平台整合，讓第三方開發者相較於 Android、Windows 等平台對 iOS 生態系產生更高黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。

- **裝置基數與使用者規模**：Apple 目前在全球約有十億付費使用者，涵蓋 iPhone、Mac、iPad、可穿戴裝置等多元產品，提供開發者極廣的潛在下載與使用者觸及機會【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- **平台收益與分潤誘因**：公司指出開發者在選擇平台時會比較「創建軟體與服務於本公司產品相較於競爭平台（如 Android、Windows）的感知利益」以及「預期可產生的營收」與「未來產品銷售成長」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。Apple 透過 App Store、廣告、訂閱等多元服務模式，讓開發者能從高毛利的服務收入中分得可觀的分潤，進一步提升黏著度。  
- **市場佔有率與開發者選擇**：雖然在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與可穿戴裝置的市場佔有率屬於少數，但 Apple 仍藉由高品質硬體與軟體整合、強大的品牌效應，使開發者即使面臨較小的市場規模，也願意投入資源以維持在 iOS 上的產品與服務【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **技術與生態系整合**：Apple 持續投入 AI 基礎建設與研發（R&D 今年度增長 34%）以提升平台功能，並將新功能（如 AI 服務）整合至 iOS、生態系服務中，讓開發者能利用最新技術快速創新，進一步鞏固其在 Apple 平台的開發投入【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- **開發者支援與風險管理**：公司亦明確指出若第三方開發者因平台市場佔有率較低而減少投入，可能會削弱產品吸引力；因此 Apple 透過持續的生態系投資與政策（如 App Store 規則、開發者工具）降低此類風險，維持開發者的長期參與【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

綜合以上因素，Apple 以龐大且活躍的使用者基礎、具吸引力的收入分潤結構、持續的技術創新與穩定的開發者支援政策，成功在第三方開發者生態系中建立起相較於 Android、Windows 更高的黏著度。

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）營收為 **131.92 億美元（$13,192 百萬）**，較 2025 年同期的 **133.71 億美元（$13,371 百萬）** 下降約 **1%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

- 成本方面，成本 of revenue 下降 **10%**，從 **60.95 億美元（$6,095 百萬）** 降至 **55.11 億美元（$5,511 百萬）**，有助於緩衝營收的下滑【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  
- 營運費用則上升 **7%**，從 **37.5 億美元（$3,750 百萬）** 增至 **40.09 億美元（$4,009 百萬）**，抵消了部分成本下降的正面效應【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  
- 受上述兩項因素相互抵銷，營業利益僅小幅提升 **4%**，從 **35.26 億美元（$3,526 百萬）** 增至 **36.72 億美元（$3,672 百萬）**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

因此，營收的微幅下滑被成本下降所抵消，但同時營運費用的上升又削弱了整體獲利的提升。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 於 2026 年 3 月 11 日完成對 Wiz 的收購，總價約 **295 億美元（$29.5 billion）**（購買價格調整後的最終金額）【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。根據購買價格分配明細，無形資產佔 83 億美元（$8.3 billion）、商譽佔 227.05 億美元（$22.705 billion），扣除已承擔的淨負債 15.38 億美元（$1.538 billion），合計 294.67 億美元（$29.467 billion）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。

records.query: Meta 最新一季總營收成長多少？主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 在2026年第一季的總營收較2025年同期增加了約 **139.97 億美元（$13,997 million）**（從 **423.14 億美元（$42,314 million）** 提升至 **563.11 億美元（$56,311 million）**）【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0】。  

主要驅動因素如下：  

1. **廣告收入** 成為最大貢獻，三個月內增加了 **136.3 億美元（$13.63 billion）**，同比成長 **33%**【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】；此增幅來自 **廣告曝光量** 年增 **19%** 以及 **每則廣告平均價格** 年增 **12%**，其中亞洲‑太平洋地區的曝光量增長尤為顯著【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  
2. **非廣告收入（FoA other）** 受 **WhatsApp 付費訊息** 與 **Meta Verified 訂閱** 推動，三個月內增長 **3.75 億美元（$375 million）**，同比 **74%**【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  
3. **Reality Labs（RL）收入** 受 **Meta Quest 銷售下降** 抵消 **AI 眼鏡銷售上升** 的影響，三個月內小幅下降 **0.1 億美元（$10 million）**（約 **2%**）【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  
4. 各主要區域的營收均有顯著提升：美國與加拿大 **+29%**、歐洲 **+39%**、亞太 **+29%**、其他地區 **+40%**（相較於2025年同季）【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #220】。  

綜合以上，廣告收入的曝光量與單價提升、非廣告服務的付費訂閱成長，以及全球主要市場的用戶與廣告需求擴張，構成 Meta 最新一季營收成長的核心動力。

[META 10-Q period 202603] Advertising

Advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $13.63 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in ad impressions delivered and average price per ad. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, ad impressions delivered increased by 19%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 5% in the same period in 2025. Ad impressions delivered during the three months ended March 31, 2026 grew in all regions, especially in Asia-Pacific, which was driven by increases in users and their engagement as well as the frequency of ads shown on our products. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the average price per ad increased by 12%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 10% in the same period in 2025. The increase in average price per ad in the three months ended March 31, 2026 was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools, and a favorable foreign currency exchange impact. This increase was partially offset by a higher number of ad impressions delivered, especially in geographies and in products, such as Reels, that monetize at lower rates. Other factors are discussed in the section entitled "—Executive Overview of First Quarter Results." In addition, the online commerce vertical was the largest contributor to the increase in advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. We anticipate that future advertising revenue will be driven by a combination of price and ad impressions delivered. Other revenue

records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在 2027 財年第一季（截至 2026 年 4 月 26 日）完全沒有向中國出貨資料中心 Hopper 系列晶片，而去年同季（2026 財年第一季）則出貨約 46 億美元【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  

- 2027 財年第一季的中國區域營收僅為 45.5 億美元，較 2026 財年第一季的 96.59 億美元大幅下降，顯示中國市場的整體需求與出貨量均大幅收縮【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #36】。  
- 這一季 NVIDIA 仍被美國政府的出口管制限制，無法向中國的資料中心市場提供符合雙方批准的產品，導致其在中國資料中心晶片市場被實質性封鎖【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #75】。  

因此，與去年同期相比，NVIDIA 本季在中國的資料中心晶片出貨從約 46 億美元降至零，營收亦出現超過一半的跌幅。

contexts: [NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] Following the rapid evolution in our businesses, we are transitioning to a new reporting framework that better reflects our current and future growth drivers. We will have two market platforms – Data Center and Edge Computing. Within Data Center, we will report two sub-markets, Hyperscale and ACIE which incorporates AI Clouds, Industrial, and Enterprise. ODMs, system integrators and distributors which we partner with to help bring our products to market. We also have partnerships in automotive, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, and technology among others, to accelerate the adoption of AI. At the foundation of the NVIDIA accelerated computing platform are our GPUs, which excel at parallel workloads such as the training and inferencing of neural networks. These Data Center systems are extreme co-designed with the GPU, CPU, NVLink switch, DPU, NIC, and scale-out networking along with software stacks and algorithms to deliver data center-scale computing solutions. While our approach starts with powerful chips, what makes it a full-stack computing platform is our large body of software, including the CUDA development platform, the CUDA-X collection of acceleration libraries, AI models and training data sets, APIs, SDKs, and domain-specific application frameworks. In addition to software delivered to customers as an integral part of our data center computing and networking platform, we offer paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade AI software and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations. In fiscal year 2025, we launched the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, a full set of data center scale infrastructure that includes GPUs, CPUs, DPUs, interconnects, switch chips and systems, and networking adapters. Blackwell excels at processing cutting edge generative AI and accelerated computing workloads with market leading performance and efficiency. Offered in a number of configurations, for customers across industries and a diverse set of AI and accelerated computing use cases. In fiscal year 2026, we unveiled the NVIDIA Rubin platform, which is expected to commence production shipments in the second half of fiscal year 2027. Built for agentic AI and reasoning, it excels at processing multi-step problem-solving and massive long-context workflows, delivering up to a 10x reduction in cost per token compared to Blackwell.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
因為 NVIDIA 提供從硬體、系統、軟體到生態系統的完整端到端 AI 加速平台，使得 AI 訓練與推論在效能、規模與開發便利性上遠超其他競爭者，幾乎成為產業事實標準【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

- **全堆疊硬體與軟體**：NVIDIA 同時提供 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU 以及高速互連，形成資料中心級別的計算與網路解決方案，讓數十萬顆 GPU 能夠互相連結成單一巨型電腦，滿足大規模 AI 模型的訓練與推論需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **專為 AI 設計的晶片與指令集**：自 2017 年推出首款 Tensor Core GPU 以來，NVIDIA 持續在 GPU 架構中加入 AI 專屬功能，提升每個運算核心的深度學習效能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- **廣泛的軟體堆疊與工具**：CUDA、NVIDIA AI Enterprise、NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等完整軟體套件，讓企業能快速部署生成式 AI、代理式 AI 以及其他高階應用，降低開發與部署門檻【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **龐大的開發者與合作生態**：全球超過 **0.075 億（7.5 百萬）** 開發者使用 CUDA 及其他 NVIDIA 軟體工具，並透過 Inception 計畫、Deep Learning Institute 與數百所大學、數萬家新創公司合作，形成強大的生態系統，進一步提升平台的價值與黏著度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **市場主導地位**：NVIDIA 的 GPU 與網路解決方案支援全球 TOP500 超過 **78%** 的超級電腦，且在 Green500 前十名系統中佔 **9 台**，顯示其在高效能運算與 AI 基礎設施上的領先優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  
- **深度研發投入**：自公司成立以來已投入超過 **767 億美元（$76.7 billion）** 於研發，持續創新 GPU、CUDA、Tensor Core、Grace CPU、Blackwell 架構等關鍵技術，確保技術領先且難以被競爭者快速複製【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **完整的產業應用與垂直整合**：NVIDIA 的平台已被醫療、金融、交通、製造、娛樂等多個千億美元規模的產業廣泛採用，提供從模型訓練、推論到專業視覺化與自動駕駛的全套解決方案，形成難以替代的垂直市場壁壘【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  

綜合上述硬體領先、軟體完整、開發者生態與市場滲透四大優勢，讓全球 AI 研發與部署幾乎必須依賴 NVIDIA 的技術，而其他公司因缺乏同等規模的全堆疊平台與生態系統，難以在短期內追趕。

微軟是透過自行研發七套新 AI 模型、投入大量 GPU 給內部研發團隊，並在 Build 2026 大會上展示的 AI 平台，讓 AI 功能能在 Microsoft 365（含 Office）等生產力軟體中提供服務【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。
