- **減少對外部前沿實驗室的依賴**：這些自建模型標誌著微軟將 AI 開發重心從外部前沿實驗室轉移至內部，以提升自主性【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- **GPU 資源配置**：公司已將大量圖形處理單元（GPU）資源分配給內部研發團隊，支援新模型與 AI 功能的開發【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸了約 **80 億美元**，主要透過購買 **Anthropic** 的可轉換公司債，並將部分債券轉換成非投票優先股，以取得 AI 技術與未來成長潛力【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。

- **初期投資**：從 2023 年第三季到 2024 年第四季，亞馬遜投入 **53 億美元** 的 Anthropic 可轉換票據，這些票據在 2024 年 12 月 31 日的估計公允價值約為 **138 億美元**，其中部分於 2025 年第一季轉換為非投票優先股，並在當期將約 **33 億美元** 的未實現盈餘重新列入「其他收入（費用），淨額」【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #36】。

- **後續追加**：2025 年第二季再投資 **13 億美元**，2025 年第四季再投資 **14 億美元**，合計自 2023 年第三季至 2025 年第四季的總投資金額達 **80 億美元**【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #63】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75】。

- **轉換與盈餘**：2025 年第三季，另一筆可轉換票據轉換為非投票優先股，當期因轉換重新列帳產生約 **23 億美元** 的盈餘；同時因可觀察價格變動，另記錄 **72 億美元** 的上調調整【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75】。

- **資產與未實現盈餘**：截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，非投票優先股的帳面金額約為 **148 億美元**，可轉換票據的公允價值約為 **458 億美元**，其中累計的未實現盈餘（列於「累積其他綜合收益（損失）」）約為 **395 億美元**【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75】。

- **會計處理**：這些可轉換票據被歸類為「可供出售」的 Level 3 資產，未實現盈虧先記錄於「累積其他綜合收益（損失）」，在轉換為股權投資時，相關未實現盈虧會重新分類至「其他收入（費用），淨額」【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #36】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75】。

- **相關商業安排**：此外，亞馬遜亦有一項主要提供 AWS 雲端服務的商業安排，包含使用 AWS 晶片，但此安排並非直接與 Anthropic 的 AI 技術掛鉤【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75】。

總結來說，亞馬遜在 AI 方面的資金投入集中於 **Anthropic**，透過多輪可轉換票據投資與股權轉換，累計投入約 **80 億美元**，並因公允價值上升與轉換產生多筆十億美元級別的盈餘與資產增值。

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. Meta 正在透過 Reality Labs 同步發展 **VR 硬體、AI 眼鏡與 AR 裝置**，目標是打造能讓使用者在沉浸式環境中同時取得 AI 助理與實體世界資訊的下一代介面，並以此推動元宇宙的長期成長。  

- 在 VR 方面，Meta 以 **Meta Quest 系列** 為核心，加入 **passthrough** 功能，使使用者在使用 VR 時仍能感知實體環境，提升沉浸感與接受度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- 在可穿戴 AI 眼鏡方面，Meta 已推出 **Ray‑Ban Meta** 與 **Oakley Meta**，這兩款眼鏡內建 **Meta AI**（先進的對話式助理）以及免手操作功能，同時配合 **Meta Neural Band** 這類利用肌電訊號控制眼鏡的腕帶【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- 為了向完整的增強實境（AR）邁進，Meta 在 2024 年展示了 **Orion 原型**（具業界領先視野的真實 AR 眼鏡），2025 年則推出 **Meta Ray‑Ban Display**，將顯示器直接嵌入鏡片，並結合上述的 Neural Band【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- 這些產品皆屬於 **Reality Labs** 的長短期計畫，Meta 表示其策略是「聚焦於 AI、可穿戴裝置與設備」以協助「將元宇宙帶入生活」並打造「下一代介面」【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】。  
- 同時，Meta 也承認此路線風險高、投資龐大，若未能成功可能會對營運與財務產生負面影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】。  

總結來說，Meta 正在把 **VR 硬體的沉浸體驗**、**AI 眼鏡的對話助理與神經控制**，以及 **AR 眼鏡的實景疊加** 結合在同一條產品路線上，期望透過這些創新裝置推動元宇宙與下一代使用者介面的發展。

- **競爭環境**：同一文件指出，全球汽車市場競爭激烈，許多既有與新興車廠正投入電動車與自動駕駛技術，且部分競爭者擁有「更大或更成熟的資源」可投入設計、製造、行銷與支援，可能導致特斯拉的車輛銷售、價格、營收與市場佔有率受壓【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

- **風險敘述**：若自動駕駛解決方案的接受度未如預期，或產品出現設計／製造缺陷，特斯拉的營運、財務狀況與未來結果都可能受到負面影響【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #70】。

[AAPL] The Board authorized another $100 billion buyback and raised the dividend 4%. Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. The company also flagged that semiconductor, NAND, and DRAM supply constraints could pressure costs into the next quarter. Story Continues

微軟的雲端服務成長相當快速，主要雲端子項目均呈現兩位數的年增率。  

- 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月（Q3）內，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 收入較去年同期 **成長 19%**，主要來自 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的每位使用者收入提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。

- 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的 **九個月**期間，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 收入 **成長 18%**，且整體 Productivity and Business Processes（含雲端）收入提升 **16%**，其中 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與雲端服務收入增加 **17%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
- 此外，Microsoft Cloud 的毛利率亦因雲端業務的規模效應而 **上升**，毛利額增加 **18%**，毛利率略有提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。

- 2025 財年淨利（Net income）: 604.58 億美元（$60,458 million），較 2024 財年的 623.6 億美元（$62,360 million） 下降，顯示淨利略有下滑【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #0】。
